newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - June 16.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - June 16.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

The industrial group said on Monday it would float its gas distribution networks in South Australia, Queensland and Northern Territory under the name of Envestra Ltd. Boral expects sales proceeds of more than A$850 million through the float, and said it would retain a 19.9 percent stake in the new company. *Australia & New Zealand Banking Group A$9.65 (-.132)
Dutch bank ING Groep N.V. chairman Aad Jacobs said there were no truth in the rumours that ING was looking to make a bid for ANZ.
Focus to remain on troubled food group after 14.4 percent of the company was acquired before the start of Friday's trade, with many bid rumours swirling the market.
The Sydney Morning Herald reported that ICI Australia's parent Imperial Chemical Industries Plc is to close bids for its planned sale of its 62.4 percent stake in the Australian company.
